title: Paris-based SquareMind, whose Swan robot uses AI for full-body dermoscopic skin imaging, raised $18M, including a previously undisclosed pre-Series A (Jim Hammerand/MassDevice)
summary: Jim Hammerand / MassDevice: Paris-based SquareMind, whose Swan robot uses AI for full-body dermoscopic skin imaging, raised $18M, including a previously undisclosed pre-Series A — SquareMind has raised $18 million for its Swan robotic skin imaging platform, including an investment from Fred Moll's Sonder Capital.
